title: First musicians he met: Art Hodes, Wellstood and Wilbur De Paris
summary: Conversations at Jimmy Ryan's with Hodes, Dick Wellstood and the Bob Wilber Bobcats.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Was Lips the first well-known musician that you got to know?

Actually, pre- – well, simultaneously with my budding friendship with Nat Lorber, I also – the first musician who – aside from this little incident with Tadd Dameron that I described – there were two musicians, both of whom were guys who were involved in proselytizing for jazz. The first one was Art Hodes. Art was – that was at Jimmy Ryan’s. Art was – he – we started talking. He wanted to know where I was from, and so on and so forth. He was very nice to me. That was around the same time at Ryan’s that I first encountered some people that I eventually got to know very well, namely the Bob Wilber Bobcats and Dick Wellstood. Dick was the first one of these young guys that I talked to. Then, Wilbur DeParis. Wilbur DeParis at the time – this was before his New Orleans band.
